motion.name: state-fast

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Compact product button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); font: 500 0.875rem system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard field for auth, filters, and chat composition.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); font: 0.875rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 30%, transparent); border-color: var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small tonal state label for status, role, visibility, and execution outcome.
components.css: .ds-chip-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; font: 600 0.75rem system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Enterprise AI Agent is a dense product workspace for users who need grounded answers, not a theatrical chatbot. The visual system should make document context, citations, tool execution, and admin state feel inspectable and trustworthy.
keyCharacteristics: Clear distinction between document work, session context, chat, citations, and admin state.
Blue accent reserved for primary action, active selection, focus, and trusted traceability.
State colors used for meaning only: success, error, warning, processing, role, visibility.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Blue is not decoration. It marks action, selection, focus, citation confidence, or traceable state.

rules.name: The Data First Rule
rules.body: Typography should clarify density, not perform personality. Reserve weight and size changes for hierarchy that affects task speed.

rules.name: The Flat Confidence Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Use shadows only for overlays or transient affordances, never as decoration on every card.

dos: Do make evidence visible: citations, trace IDs, tool results, and agent steps should remain easy to scan.
Do use compact density for enterprise workflows, with enough contrast and spacing to prevent gray noise.
Do standardize buttons, selects, tabs, chips, tables, and focus states across user and admin surfaces.
Do keep motion short and state-driven, with reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't create a toy-like AI chat interface.
Don't drift into ordinary SaaS-template gloss.
Don't let the UI become gray, flat, and lifeless.
Don't hide source traceability behind decorative chat bubbles.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe card accents, or decorative shadows as a default.
